records.title: XRP derivatives dashboard — 00:52 UTC snapshot
records.summary: At 00:52 UTC on 2026-10-31, Liqwall displayed XRP at $1.26, aggregated open interest of $1.32B (-1.9% over 24 hours), $6.1M liquidations over 24 hours ($4.4M longs and $1.7M shorts), average funding +0.0059% per eight hours, Binance funding +0.0087%, and 72.1% of Binance XRP-position accounts long.
records.limitations: Single third-party provider snapshot. Exchange/contract coverage and aggregation methodology are not independently reconciled here. Account-count long/short ratios are not notional exposure. This observation is context-only and is not a directional forecast or admitted model feature.

records.title: Daily XRP ETF holdings and flows by fund
records.summary: The dataset tracks six U.S. spot XRP funds plus BITW. It reports +3,440,288 XRP net holdings change over 2026-10-26 through 2026-10-29 and 1,196,650,118 XRP held on 2026-10-29. The provider says funds excluded from computed flows count as zero; the 2026-10-30 row is provisional.
records.limitations: Aggregated issuer-reported holdings, not a direct measure of net new external capital or unhedged spot buying. Flow-excluded funds counted as zero can understate/alter the aggregate. The 2026-10-30 row is provisional and is excluded from settled-flow totals.

records.title: XRP ETF dashboard — five-fund flow snapshot
records.summary: Alpha Finance reports five U.S. spot XRP funds, +$8.4M net flow on 2026-10-29, +$98.9M over 30 sessions, and $1.73B cumulative flow. It identifies XRPZ as the largest 2026-10-29 inflow at $5.6M. Its displayed 2026-10-29 XRP close is $1.3255.
records.limitations: Five-fund universe differs from XRP Insights' six spot funds plus BITW. The displayed $1.3255 price differs materially from XRP Insights' $1.25 reference for the same date; price bases/timestamps are unresolved and neither is used as a synchronized spot-price feature. Aggregator flow is not proof of new external capital.

records.title: USDC circulation and supported blockchain networks
records.summary: Circle's USDC page displays $70.0B in circulation as of 2026-10-29 and says USDC is natively issued on 38 blockchains as of 2026-09-16, including Base and the XRPL. Circle states USDC is fully backed by cash and cash-equivalent assets and redeemable 1:1 for USD.
records.limitations: The $70B figure is global supply, not Base or XRPL supply. The network count is dated 2026-09-16. This does not identify Circle as a supplier/lender in the cbXRP/USDC Morpho market or establish Base↔XRPL flow. Reserve statements are company disclosures; reserve attestations must be inspected separately.

records.title: Crypto-backed loans — XRP collateral and USDC borrowing limits
records.summary: Coinbase's current product page says crypto-backed loans are powered by Morpho on Base, USDC is deposited into the Coinbase account, and the chosen crypto is moved onchain to Morpho as collateral. The page lists up to $100,000 USDC against XRP (separate from the larger BTC/ETH limits) and describes U.S. availability excluding New York at launch.
records.limitations: Product terms and regional availability can change. Coinbase does not disclose XRP loan originations, borrower counts, aggregate XRP collateral, Coinbase's share of the permissionless Morpho market, or onward use of borrowed USDC.

records.title: Crypto-backed loans — eligible collateral, restrictions and protocol control
records.summary: Coinbase Help lists XRP as eligible collateral, says availability is for verified U.S. customers excluding New York with limited access in the UK and Canada, explains variable/fixed-rate options, and states loan proceeds cannot be used for trading on Coinbase. It also says Coinbase provides access to Morpho but does not control the protocol.
records.limitations: Does not disclose loan balances by collateral asset, customer-level borrowing, market-ID mapping or off-platform use of proceeds. Region and asset eligibility may vary by loan type and change over time.

records.title: Investors pull money from U.S. equity funds ahead of AI hyperscaler earnings
records.summary: Reuters, citing LSEG Lipper, reports that U.S. equity funds had $6.65B net weekly outflows for the week ended 2026-10-28; money-market funds had $47.66B outflows; sector funds had $3.52B inflows including $4.54B into technology; and U.S. bond funds had $2.04B inflows.
records.limitations: One weekly U.S. fund-flow observation, not crypto or XRP flow. Sector/technology and bond inflows show the move was not uniformly risk-off. It cannot establish a causal effect on XRP.

records.title: Binance sets aside over $6.34 billion to cover losses from attack
records.summary: Reuters reports Binance said it reserved more than $6.34B in company funds, including $5B already held in impacted token assets, and that $3B in assets had been frozen with industry partners. Binance said user funds would be publicly verified through its proof-of-reserves process.
records.limitations: Aggregate USD figures relayed from Binance. No XRP-specific replenishment amount, token-by-token reserve coverage or official membership of the five XRPL incident source wallets in the October 1 PoR set is established.
